name: iammagnus Jobs — Scholarship category

extractionHints.detail: WordPress + WP Job Manager. Listings are job_listing posts, so scholarship entries share a template with ordinary job adverts — confirm a post is actually a scholarship before extracting, rather than assuming the category is clean.

notes: DISCOVERY authority, deliberately the narrowest config of the four. The site's wp-sitemap-posts-job_listing-1.xml enumerates 580 listings, but sampling showed they are overwhelmingly ordinary job adverts ('cabin-crew-member-at-green-africa-lagos'), so the sitemap is NOT used — crawling all 580 and sending them to an extractor would be the worst cost/value in the pipeline. Instead this BFSes the /category/scholarship/ taxonomy, whose pagination is plain hrefs. Cloudflare shows an intermittent bot-verification interstitial: curl with a declared UA got 200 on 2026-09-05, but headless Chromium is more likely to trip it than curl, so treat a failed run as expected rather than surprising. Review yield after the first run — if it produces fewer than ~20 genuine scholarships, mark this source DEPRECATED rather than maintaining it.
